meta.name: Dhirwa
references: Apple Human Interface Guidelines as the review standard, read through dickwu/apple-design-skill (not copied into this repo)
The dot of ذ, the first letter of the name, read as the summit point
Kept from earlier identities: the name, the ridge-and-gold-point mark, the country accents, the Genjitsu directives
meta.audience: Arabic-speaking secondary students (grades 10-12) across the GCC and Egypt, the parents who pay, and the teachers who sell
meta.notes: Colours are chosen, not measured from a reference image. tokens.css is authoritative; DESIGN.md explains the rules.

surface.usage: Neutral grounds. The device picks the theme; a toggle can force one

primary.usage: Actions are ink pills, white pills in dark. Text on them flips with them

accent.name: summit gold
accent.usage: One meaning: the summit point and what a student reached or earned. Never text on the ground

neutral.usage: Lightest to darkest in light, darkest to lightest in dark

countries.usage: Carry data: one accent per country

families.mark: Reem Kufi 700: the Arabic wordmark only
families.data: IBM Plex Sans Arabic, tabular numerals

spacing.density: airy on marketing pages, comfortable in the app, dense in admin tables

layout.phone_navigation: Bottom tab bar for signed-in users

elevation.dark: No paper shadow; surfaces separate by value

iconography.mark: Three nested ridge lines closing on one peak, a gold point above them. 64×48 grid. Never flipped

motion.reduced_motion: All durations 0; GSAP shows the final frame

components.button: Pill, 44px minimum, ink fill or hairline outline
components.card: Surface, 22px radius, hairline, soft shadow in light
components.tab_bar: Glass, fixed to the bottom on phones, icons with labels, current tab bold

design_style.visual_language: Large type, generous space, one colour with one meaning
design_style.composition: One idea per section; fewer boxes
design_style.imagery: No stock photos. Subject icons, country flags, real course covers, and sample UI labelled as an example
design_style.interaction_feel: Marketing moves once and rests; the app stays calm
design_style.brand_voice_in_ui: Encouraging, exact, never hype. 'Your next step' over 'Unlock your potential'

overview.effect_intensity: medium on marketing pages, none in app pages
overview.performance_tier: SVG and transforms on marketing pages; one WebGL canvas, the subject trail on the student home

3d_elements.description: The subject trail on the student home (components/three/ride-scene.ts), moved only by the student

scroll_effects.description: GSAP ScrollTrigger on native scroll: reveals and pinned sections on marketing pages, pinning through CSS sticky. No wheel hijacking

glassmorphism_neumorphism.description: The floating header and phone tab bar only; solid under reduced transparency and increased contrast

svg_animations.description: The intro: ridges draw, the gold point climbs to the peak, the mark shrinks into its header position. About 2.6 s, once per tab session, any input skips

visual_effects.composite_notes: The word ذروة / Dhirwa is DOM text, so it stays translatable and selectable. The mark never mirrors in RTL.
